submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) at 35 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.888% at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate. This significantly outperforms Algorithm-L2 (best: 84.45% at 40 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (best: 73.76% at 40 GeV). The 35 GeV threshold was identified as optimal through systematic simulation studies across the allowed 20-60 GeV range, showing peak performance at this value. All hardware constraints are satisfied: the algorithm fits within the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs) and the 25 Gb/s optical links have sufficient bandwidth. This recommendation maximizes physics reach for the new signature while respecting all technical constraints.
